glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_kamui.desc: Rogue EFFECT (Void, Circle 4; tribute to Obito's Sharingan, Naruto). On yourself (Self): enter the Kamui dimension — your screen turns blue, nobody can hit you and you can't hit anybody (strikes, arrows, spells and effects pass through) and monsters lose sight of you. You're pushed out after 2 min, or leave by sneaking twice quickly or casting again. On a WEAK enemy (max health up to 40): it's sucked into the dimension for 8 s (Extend +) and comes back at the same spot, dazed. Strong or boss: space only twists (5 damage and slowness). Enemy player (PvP): trapped in the dimension for 5 s. Unlock: Rogue, Circle 4.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_d4c.desc: Steel Ball EFFECT (Void, Circle 5; tribute to Valentine's Dirty Deeds Done Dirt Cheap, JoJo). On yourself (Self): you hide BETWEEN dimensions — light-blue screen, intangible (nobody hits you, you hit nobody), pushed out after 2 min, or leave by sneaking twice quickly or casting again. On a weak enemy (max health up to 50): 3 damage and it's thrown between two worlds for 5 s (Extend +), coming back sick (Weakness and slowness). Strong or boss: squeezed between dimensions (7 damage, Slowness III). Enemy player (PvP): trapped for 3 s. Unlock: Steel Ball, Circle 5.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_spiritual_pressure: Shinigami EFFECT (Shadow, Circle 3; tribute to Reiatsu, Bleach). Your pressure = (10 + 1.2 × your level) × power. On yourself (Self): 10 s aura (Extend +), radius 6 (Expand +) — enemies with max health up to HALF your pressure KNEEL (rooted, Slowness V, Weakness II); up to your full pressure they feel heavy (Slowness II, Weakness); up to double it they get Slowness I. Bosses only feel a slight weight. Players only in PvP, and only the weight. On a target: the same rule on it alone for 5 s. Unlock: Shinigami, Circle 3.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_titan_mode.desc: Smith TRANSFORMATION BODY (Earth, Circle 5; tribute to the War Hammer Titan, Attack on Titan). Use inside the Transformation form (Transformation → Titan Mode → ...). For 30 s (Extend +) you become HUGE: size ×2.2, +20 max health, +2.5 reach, +4 damage, knockback resistance, step up blocks without jumping — but 15% slower. Every melee hit makes a STOMP that hits the enemies around the target (40% of the hit). Steam rises from your body, and when it ends it evaporates. Unlock: Smith, Circle 5 (also teaches the Transformation form).
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_return_to_zero.des: Steel Ball EFFECT (Light, Circle 6; tribute to Gold Experience Requiem, JoJo). On you or an ally: for 20 s (Extend +) the NEXT attack or technique anyone aims at you is NULLIFIED — damage, arrow, spell or harmful effect — and whoever tried is returned to zero: the action is cancelled (Stunned 2 s; bosses ½ s), it loses its target and is pushed back. One use only. 60 s cooldown (while it recharges the spell doesn't go off and costs no mana). Unlock: Steel Ball, Circle 6.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_santen_kesshun.des: Enchanter EFFECT (Light, Circle 2; tribute to Orihime's Shun Shun Rikka, Bleach). On you or an ally: a TRIANGULAR shield that blocks the next 3 hits from anyone (+1 per Amplify) for 15 s (Extend +). Arrows stop on the shield. Unlock: Enchanter, Circle 2.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_soten_kisshun.desc: Enchanter EFFECT (Light, Circle 3; tribute to Orihime's Shun Shun Rikka, Bleach). "Rejects" what happened to you or an ally: heals 6, removes ALL harmful effects, puts out fire and repairs 8% of the durability of armor and held items. Unlock: Enchanter, Circle 3.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_koten_zanshun.desc: Enchanter EFFECT (Light, Circle 4; tribute to Orihime's Shun Shun Rikka, Bleach). Tsubaki flies through ONE target per cast: 8 damage, tears away absorption hearts and "rejects" its strongest beneficial effect. Unlock: Enchanter, Circle 4.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_projection.desc: Gunslinger EFFECT (Wind, Circle 3; tribute to Naoya Zen'in's Projection Sorcery, Jujutsu Kaisen). On yourself (Self): you advance in FRAMES — 4 quick steps of 1.75 blocks (Extend +2 steps), stopping before walls; whoever you touch on the way must keep up. On a target (or whoever you touch): 4 damage; whoever CAN'T keep up — a weak creature (max health up to 30) — is TRAPPED in a translucent frame, Stunned 1.5 s (+½ s per Amplify). Enemy player (PvP): ¾ s. Strong or boss: only slowed. Unlock: Gunslinger, Circle 3.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_vector_reflect.des: Mage EFFECT (Wind, Circle 3; tribute to Accelerator, A Certain Magical Index). On you or an ally for 4 s (Extend +): every incoming projectile goes BACK to its shooter, faster; knockback doesn't move you; melee hits lose 40% and send the attacker flying. Unlock: Mage, Circle 3.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_vector_punch.desc: Mage EFFECT (Wind, Circle 2; tribute to Accelerator, A Certain Magical Index). 7 damage and the hit's whole vector becomes a HUGE push in the direction you're looking (+ per Amplify; bosses barely move). Unlock: Mage, Circle 2.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_vector_burst.desc: Mage EFFECT (Wind, Circle 4; tribute to Accelerator, A Certain Magical Index). Wind is pulled into a point for ⅓ s and blasts outward: 5 damage and a strong push on every enemy within radius 4 (Expand +). At the target hit, or around you (Self). Unlock: Mage, Circle 4.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_shadow_toad.desc: Necromancer EFFECT (Shadow, Circle 2; tribute to Megumi's Ten Shadows, Jujutsu Kaisen). A shadow toad rises from the ground and its tongue pulls: on an enemy, 2 damage and it's dragged right in front of you (bosses are only slowed). On yourself (Self): the toad pulls you to where you're aiming, up to 16 blocks — a grappling hook. Unlock: Necromancer, Circle 2.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_mahoraga_wheel.des: Warlock EFFECT (Shadow, Circle 5; tribute to the shikigami Mahoraga, Jujutsu Kaisen). The eight-spoked wheel turns above your head (or an ally's) for 30 s (Extend +): each hit of a damage TYPE turns the wheel toward that type, and the next one of the same type hurts 20% less — up to −80% on the 4th turn. Fire, arrows, bites, magic... each adapts separately. Unlock: Warlock, Circle 5.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_dead_calm.desc: Knight EFFECT (Water, Circle 4; tribute to the Water Breathing 11th form, Demon Slayer). Use with Self: for 3 s (Extend +) you stand in a field of still water — every incoming melee hit and projectile is PARRIED and the attacker takes a counter cut (6 × power). You move slowly while it lasts. Unlock: Knight, Circle 4.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_return_by_death.de: Witch EFFECT (Shadow, Circle 6; tribute to Subaru, Re:Zero). Use with Self: marks a RETURN POINT (place, health and hunger) for 60 s (Extend +). If you die within that time, the death is undone: the screen goes black and you're back at the point with the health you had, with no harmful effects. After it saves you, it works again only after 10 min. Unlock: Witch, Circle 6.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_flower_field.desc: Druid EFFECT (Nature, Circle 3; Frieren's favorite spell). A field of flowers (radius 5, Expand +) for 10 s (Extend +) — on you, an ally, or where the spell hits the ground. Allies inside recover 1 health per second; ordinary monsters calm down (lose their target and walk slowly). Only petals: no blocks are placed. Unlock: Druid, Circle 3.
Ranger EFFECT (Shadow, Circle 3; tribute to Shikamaru, Naruto). Your shadow stretches out and binds the enemy: for 4 s (Extend +) it copies YOUR movements — walks when you walk, stops when you stop, backs off if you back off. Bosses: 1 s. Enemy player (PvP): 2 s. Breaks beyond 16 blocks. Unlock: Ranger, Circle 3.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lk_aschente.desc: Gambler EFFECT (Light, Circle 3; tribute to the Ten Pledges of No Game No Life). You challenge the enemy to an 8 s game (Extend +): whoever deals MORE damage to the other wins. If you win, it loses 25% of its max health (bosses 5%) and gets Weakness II; if you lose, you get Weakness and lose 20% of your mana. Tie: nothing. One game at a time. Unlock: Gambler, Circle 3.
